extracted.name: No-Mayonnaise Ranch Dressing
extracted.description: If you do not like mayonnaise, this recipe is for you! It's so creamy, you'll never be able to tell that it's reduced fat! Couldn't be easier!
instruction_lines: Place sour cream and buttermilk into a mixing bowl. Season with parsley, chives, garlic powder, dill, onion powder, salt, and pepper. Whisk together until smooth. Cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes before serving.
